dedupe_keys.name: obcinske ceste v mestni obcini slovenj gradec

description: Občinske ceste v mestni občini Slovenj Gradec is a dataset listed in Slovenia’s open data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by MESTNA OBČINA SLOVENJ GRADEC. Record of data on municipal roads in the municipality of Slovenj Gradec in the Collective Cadastre of Commercial Public Infrastructure of the Surveying and Mapping Authority of the Republic of Slovenia. The collection contains line displays of the axis of municipal roads and their categorisation. Coverage: MESTNA OBČINA SLOVENJ GRADEC. The portal shows the English title as "Municipal roads in the municipality of Slovenj Gradec" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is MESTNA OBČINA SLOVENJ GRADEC. Its keywords include ceste, cestno omrežje, občinske ceste, kategorizacija cest. The listing shows 3 download or service links in HTML, PDF. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-odprti-podatki-slovenije.
